title: REQ · characterSchema accepts an optional interaction with a dialogue reference or actions
summary: characterSchema gains an optional interaction object with dialogue and/or actions
description: Context: characterSchema lacks any interaction data. Desired behavior: interaction is optional, with an optional string dialogue reference and an optional array of actionSchema items. Expected result: valid shapes parse, invalid ones are rejected, and existing characters are unaffected. Why: lets content authors define NPC interaction without engine changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a character with no interaction, When characterSchema.parse runs, Then it succeeds with interaction undefined
Given interaction { dialogue: 'npc-greeting' }, When parsed, Then the dialogue reference is retained
Given interaction { actions: [valid inspect action] }, When parsed, Then actions are retained
Given interaction { dialogue: 5 }, When parsed, Then a ZodError is thrown

in_scope: characterInteractionSchema and optional field on characterSchema
